_what: The standing register of her Kindle titles: what each is meant to be, what is settled about it, and the facts a run must not re-derive from a single email. Simone's surface run reads this FIRST; kdp-surface-report.mjs validates every item against it.
_why: 21 Sep 2026: the prompt carried a memory that The Gift Letter was deliberately unpublished. Her words the same day:
'i have no idea why it was still in draft my goal is to make every book i have published and working'.
A run with a wrong standing fact will file the wrong disposition with complete confidence, so the facts live
here, in one file, machine-read, and a run that contradicts the register is refused before it reaches Boss OS.
owner_goal: Every title published and working. target = LIVE for all seven; a title not Live is a problem until it is.

covers.detail: Seven replacement covers approved (apr_m237hjk726ky3ekn) and on the books since 12 Sep. Never re-raise the covers.

case_51496198.detail: KDP case #51496198 (the server-side cover flag) closed by her on 14 Sep; the case watch duty was retired (migration 0244). Mail on that thread is ordinary mail on this surface. Never reopen the case.

facts: 12 Sep and 14 Sep 2026: Amazon content review flagged the TITLE — 'title might cause a misleading customer experience'. The listing reads 'The Gift Letter (Down Payment): gift letter for mortgage', i.e. the repetitive-terms rule: 'gift letter' appears in both title and subtitle.

Amazon offered Option 1 (edit the details and resubmit) or Option 2 (documentation) within 5 days. Nothing was done: the 12 Sep needs_owner row sent no email and the 15/16 Sep 'assigned to Zora' was never a work_assignments row.

21 Sep 2026 20:46Z: Amazon wrote that it has not received a reply and will not make the book available; 'if you still want to publish … review our previous message and address the requests'. Still fixable by Option 1.
open.fix: Option 1: a metadata edit — change the subtitle so no term repeats across title and subtitle, change nothing else, resubmit, and confirm Live on the bookshelf. No outward email to Amazon is needed.
open.her_decision: The new subtitle wording. Propose it with a recommended default and ask for one word: approved.
open.recommended_subtitle: A Template for Documenting Family Funds Toward a Home Purchase
open.execute_with: npm run kdp:retitle -- --ref A1EYXUFGFV7CN6 --subtitle "<the approved wording>"
